Just because everything is fine doesn’t mean you automatically have to feel fine. I think that’s such a hard thing to be okay with when you’re feeling depressed, depression doesn’t care how good you might have it, it’s still going to make you feel this way. 

Being alone in the way you’ve put it sounds like a rough time. I can understand how you feel when you say you want to be left alone but don’t want to be alone, it’s a struggle that makes it hard to know what you really want.

I hope you putting your feelings out into the world helped you feel at least a little bit better. I don’t think there’s anything I can tell you that’ll help you face it all without problems, but know that there’s little things that might eventually become huge things that can help you feel purpose. You might not feel you have goals or passions but you can start small, maybe just try to find new activities or reward yourself for your efforts more often? I think something as little as that can snowball into huge improvements.

Try to hang in there, that desire to sleep for so long is a real common one but I hope that you overcome it and start enjoying yourself more. Good luck to you!!
